scores.rationale: About 19 Biggles, mostly unjacketed or Dean reprints with a few jacketed Brockhampton/Hodder copies; firsts unverified, worn.
Matching six-volume Harrow prize calf set with Birket Foster Routledge poets; decorative, sound, modest collector demand.
Probable four-volume Cassell Churchill set in jackets plus two Hawthorn Kimber firsts in jackets; rest is filler.
1899 Bulletin Christmas number and early axemen's programme are the best items in an otherwise ordinary ephemera box.
Common Dickens reprints; Sevres-style teapot and plated jug probably later decorative pieces, sold as is.
Two boxed 10 inch Walking Dead figures and a pop-up book; modest collector market.
Two Regency hand-coloured plates plus an unverified Art Deco pochoir plate; framed, value depends on authenticity.
Common modern Tasmaniana paperbacks; deeds are unclear in date and place, minor interest.
Lace reference books are mostly later reprints with a steady but small specialist market.
Bles Lion, Witch and Wardrobe in Baynes jacket (impression unknown, mix of early and late) plus Pixie O'Harris, Twain and Flora of NZ.
